body:
Follow-ups from a full read of the 38 commits that landed after 3.0.1 (the review fixes). Three small things; everything else read correct.

* Android's new category-merge confirmation (T-270) remembered the category by its ROW INDEX from when the question was asked and applied it when the user confirmed. A sync that reorders or shrinks the category list while the dialog is open makes that index point at a different category, so confirming could rename the wrong one. It now remembers the name, resolves it at confirm time, and drops the rename if the category has meanwhile disappeared.
* The wire contract named only `server-merge` as a reserved `updated_by` literal, but the server also writes `server-orphan` (a list orphaned by its last member leaving) and, since T-258, `server-list-delete` (the items of a list a client tombstoned). All three are documented now.
* A KDoc paragraph in AuthRepository that my own T-260 edit had left with a stray line break.
title: Follow-ups from re-reading the post-3.0.1 fixes: merge-confirm race, reserved literals, comment
